admin.title: Fraud screening
admin.lead: Rules run when an order is accepted, and the ban list. Orders at or above the threshold are held for review on the order page.
admin.rules_hint: Each rule adds to a risk score; at the threshold the order is moved to “fraud” and nothing is provisioned.
admin.hold_score_hint: Ban list 100, disposable e-mail 60, card stored by another client 50, IP velocity 40, other accounts from the IP 40, client velocity 30 points.
admin.max_orders_per_ip: Max. orders from one IP in 24 h
admin.max_clients_per_ip: Other accounts from one IP in 24 h
admin.max_orders_per_client: Max. orders of one client in 24 h
admin.invalid_value: Not a valid value for this kind (e-mail, domain or IP / CIDR).
admin.bans_hint: Orders from listed e-mail addresses, domains (including subdomains) or IP networks are held.
